en.why: The number of words in the caption matches the number of accessories one to one, and the forward and reverse runs are symmetric, so the move is reversible. Accessory sizes step down from large to small, which gives the row a sense of perspective. The row has no guide lines or labels.
spec: Film 10.5s in three shots (A 0–3.9s, B 3.9–7.6s, lockup C 7.6–10.5s), with two dispense passes. Each pass: extend 0.9s (27 frames), hold 1.1s (33 frames), retract 0.9s (27 frames); pass 1 extends 0.5–1.4s and retracts 2.5–3.4s, pass 2 extends 4.3–5.2s and retracts 6.3–7.2s. Accessories start 0.15s apart (about 5 frames), each slide-out takes 0.3s (9 frames)
Slide-out cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) (expo.out); the retract is the exact time mirror of the extend; camera push sine.inOut; wordmark and subtitle expo.out

Perspective, locked side view at 13° fov with lens shift so the dock sits left and the row centre-right (shots A and C); shot B is a three-quarter view from the left at 23° fov so the row recedes in depth; 3% push-in per shot (scale 1.00→1.03); motion blur from 14 sub-frames over a 180° shutter

5 power adapters (140W, 96W, 70W, 35W, 20W) leave the dock's right face to the right and form a row sized from large to small, 0.42 units apart; the smallest leaves first and travels furthest, the largest leaves last; on retract they re-enter in the mirrored order, from right to left

Each accessory that slides out adds one word to the caption 0.1s after it starts moving, which appears directly with no fade (5 words, 5 accessories); on retract, words are removed in reverse order at 0.15s intervals

Light gray-white background #f4f4f6, matte white product (#f4f4f3, roughness 0.62), large soft overhead box plus broad front fill, soft contact shadows on an invisible floor; no tone mapping; dark gray type #1d1d1f (50px captions, 156px wordmark)
en.prompt: Build an accessory showcase called Dispense Line-up as a 10.5-second film. Light gray-white background (#f4f4f6) with a matte white charging dock in a locked side view (13° fov, lens shift so the dock sits left and the row centre-right). 5 power adapters (140W, 96W, 70W, 35W, 20W) slide out of the dock's right face to the right and form a row sized from large to small: the smallest leaves first and travels furthest, each next one starts 0.15 seconds later, each slide-out takes 0.3 seconds with expo.out (cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)), 0.9 seconds in total. Each time one starts moving, the caption below gains one word 0.1 seconds later that appears directly with no fade; the word count matches the accessory count. After a 1.1 second hold, retract as the exact time mirror over 0.9 seconds: the accessories return from right to left into the dock while the caption deletes word by word in reverse. Run two passes (0.5s and 4.3s start) with a second caption, cutting to a three-quarter view from the left (23° fov) for the second one, then end on the side view with the wordmark fading in at 7.75s (expo.out, blur 10px→0). Push in 3% over every shot with sine.inOut. Soft overhead light, soft contact shadows, 14-sub-frame motion blur on moving parts. Drive the 3D from a time function so the retract is a mirror, and use GSAP only for the caption words and wordmark.
says: Accessories come out of the product one by one and line up
Text pops up word by word as they come out
Then they go back in one by one
vs: Text–Object Interleave is front-and-back occlusion between text and object; the caption in Dispense Line-up syncs only with the accessory count.
Converge to Mark gathers many elements into one icon; the retract in Dispense Line-up returns to the original subject and creates no new shape.

en.title: Dispense Line-up: Example and Code Recipe
en.description: Five power adapters slide out of a dock into a row while the caption appears word by word, then retract in mirror order. Make it with Claude Code or Codex.
en.lede: Accessories slide out of the main object one by one into a row while the caption appears word by word, then retract in mirror order.
en.name: Dispense Line-up

body.h2: How to make a Dispense Line-up with Claude Code or Codex
body.body:
Model a dock and five adapters (140W, 96W, 70W, 35W, 20W) in 3D. Each pass extends in 0.9s, holds 1.1s and retracts 0.9s. Accessories start 0.15s apart and each slides out in 0.3s on expo.out, cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1). The smallest leaves first and travels furthest, and the row steps from large to small, 0.42 units apart.

Add one caption word 0.1s after each accessory starts moving, appearing with no fade (5 words, 5 accessories). The retract is the exact time mirror: accessories re-enter right to left and words are removed in reverse at 0.15s intervals. Use a locked side view at 13° fov with lens shift, a 23° three-quarter view for shot B, and 14 sub-frames of motion blur.

Press the copy button to send this recipe to Claude Code or Codex, or install the skill once with npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard. The agent builds the dock, the adapters and the caption timing. Render an MP4 with HyperFrames, or port the GSAP timeline to your website.

en.alt: Six white USB-C chargers lined up from largest to smallest above the line "240W across five USB-C ports."
faq: A dispense animation moves several objects out of one source object one after another, usually into a line. The delay between items and a mirrored return make the motion read as one mechanism.
How do I sync captions to the objects?

Tie each caption word to an accessory start time. Here a word appears 0.1s after its accessory starts moving and words disappear in reverse order at 0.15s intervals on retract, so the word count matches the accessory count.

zh.title: 配件依次滑出排列：示例与代码配方
zh.description: 五个电源适配器从底座里逐个滑出排成一行，文案逐词出现，停留后镜像收回。用 Claude Code 或 Codex 按免费配方做出这个效果。
zh.lede: 配件从主体里逐个滑出排成一行，文案逐词同步出现，停留后对称收回。
zh.name: 配件依次滑出排列动画

body.h2: 用 Claude Code 或 Codex 做配件依次滑出排列动画
body.body:
用 3D 做一个底座和五个适配器（140W、96W、70W、35W、20W）。每一轮展开 0.9s、停留 1.1s、收回 0.9s。配件间隔 0.15s 依次出发，各自用 0.3s 滑出，缓动 expo.out（cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)）。最小的先出发、走得最远，一排从大到小，间距 0.42 个单位。

每个配件开始移动 0.1s 后，文案多出一个词，直接出现，不加淡入（5 个词对应 5 个配件）。收回是展开的严格时间镜像：配件从右到左回到底座，文案按相反顺序、每 0.15s 去掉一个词。镜头用锁定的侧视角（视场角 13°，带镜头位移），B 镜头用 23° 的四分之三视角，运动模糊取 14 个子帧。

点击复制按钮，把配方发给 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以用 npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard 安装 skill。agent 会搭出底座、适配器和文案时间轴。可以用 HyperFrames 渲染成 MP4，也可以把 GSAP 时间线移植到网站上。

zh.alt: 六个白色 USB-C 充电器从大到小排成一排，下方写着五个 USB-C 口共 240W。

把每个词绑定到对应配件的出发时间。这里词在配件开始移动 0.1s 后出现，收回时按相反顺序每 0.15s 去掉一个词，词数与配件数一一对应。
